g.text: Test 5: robustness of the mean payoff across samples and definitions

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Data: Cboe via FRED (VIXCLS); S&P 500 via Yahoo Finance; VXO via FRED (VXOCLS). Sign: implied − realised (positive = variance seller gains). Newey–West 6 lags (monthly), 30 lags (daily overlapping). Blue = CI excludes 0; grey = does not. p_Holm: Holm-adjusted across the variants.
